candidates.original_title: Distinction bias: Misprediction and mischoice due to joint evaluation
candidates.description: People in joint evaluation mode overpredict happiness differences between quantitatively different word tasks but not between qualitatively different word tasks.
candidates.citation_sentence: we successfully replicated Study 1, from Hsee and Zhang (2004), but not Study 2.
candidates.notes: Study 2 results are explicitly called 'inconclusive' by the authors; some comparisons support distinction bias and some do not. The paper states 'the results of Study 2 in the present paper are inconclusive and, in general, do not replicate the focal results of Study 2 from Hsee and Zhang (2004).'
